summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a preliminary pricing supplement (Rule 424(b)(5), Registration No. 333-295759) for Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon (With Memory) Barrier Notes due October 11, 2028, issued under its Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program. Terms: $1,000 stated principal per note, quarterly contingent coupon of $50.00 (with memory), quarterly call observation dates beginning April 7, 2027, pricing date October 7, 2026, original issue date October 9, 2026, valuation October 9, 2028. Notes are senior unsecured obligations linked to the worst-performing of Autodesk, Cooper Companies, Gen Digital and Qualcomm common stocks. Aggregate principal amount left blank. This is a routine structured note takedown under an existing shelf, not a special situation; no M&A, activist, tender or restructuring event. Watch credit risk and underlying correlation.
